scope.note: Only releases listed in the official fripSide Discography are included. The official Discography lists no DIGITAL or EP releases in this date range.

normalization_policy.release_types: Best albums, anthologies, and explicitly named compilations normalize to compilation; other official ALBUM/SINGLE values normalize directly.
normalization_policy.edition_fingerprint: SHA-256 of ordered audio discs and normalized song-version slugs derived from the official display titles. Identical fingerprints share one normalized audio program; package editions and catalog numbers remain aliases/metadata.
normalization_policy.songs_and_versions: Typography and credited-artist suffixes are normalized at song level. Explicit remix, instrumental, edit, arrangement, and numbered/version-year labels become song versions.
normalization_policy.relations: Relations are assigned only when the official version label determines the relation with reasonable confidence. Ambiguous labels retain null parent/relation plus uncertainty_reason.
